catalog.summary: 0-bg grid with ONE multi-cell TEMPLATE shape (3-5 cells, color A) and 2-4 SINGLE-cell MARKERS (color B != A) at scattered isolated positions. Rule: on a blank canvas, stamp the template's shape at EACH marker (template's top-left aligned to the marker), recolored to the first marker's color; out-of-bounds cells clip. Net: the template is replicated at every marker in the marker color. (Was: 3-4 blobs, no markers -> rule returned a blank grid.)

catalog.summary: 0-bg grid (h~9-14, w~7-10) with 3-5 ENDPOINT PAIRS placed in distinct columns. Each pair places two SAME-COLOR cells in the same column at rows r1 < r2 with r2 ≥ r1 + 2 (so there is at least one empty cell between them). Different pairs use distinct non-bg colors. Rule: for each column containing exactly two same-color cells at rows r1 and r2, FILL every cell at rows r1+1 .. r2-1 in that column with that color (BRIDGING the gap into a solid vertical bar). Endpoints stay; non-pair columns stay 0. Net: each pair of isolated endpoints becomes a continuous colored vertical line.
